meta.title: Improve putAll efficiency
meta.body_summary: Optimize CompactMap.putAll for large bulk inserts by switching to a backing map representation and copying entries directly, with regression tests.

perf_labels.notes: Self-merged putAll bulk-insert optimization adding regression tests; no review or benchmark evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 77 changed lines across 2 files, this is a very small edit by absolute volume. It fits a small-step, low-risk performance PR, consistent with the immediate self-merge without review.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review or PR comments were provided; the PR was self-merged by the author immediately after creation.
review_details.performance_claim: Detect large bulk inserts in CompactMap.putAll and copy entries directly to a backing map to improve performance versus per-entry put.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Small, focused optimization within a custom data structure; the agent correctly identified the bulk-insert path and added regression tests; no boundary friction due to immediate maintainer merge.

detection_detail.code_reading: The author/agent analyzed the putAll method and detected that large bulk inserts could be optimized by switching to a backing map representation instead of iterating put.

core_change_summary.description: In CompactMap.putAll(), detect if the number of incoming entries exceeds a threshold; if so, copy all existing entries into a backing map and then put the new entries, bypassing the per-entry put logic. Added CompactMapPutAllTest to verify representation switch behavior.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The test file is the only other change; it ensures the bulk optimization path is exercised correctly.
